svg.title: MetricsSystem — Per-JVM Dropwizard Sources, Sinks & Servlets
svg.desc: Driver, Executor & AM MetricsSystem bootstrap, internal Source registration, SparkUI /metrics/* mount, and stop cleanup. 1. SparkEnv to Driver MetricsSys: createMetricsSystem() (in-JVM); 2. DAGScheduler to Driver MetricsSys: registerSource(DAGSched) (in-JVM); 3. ApplicationMaster to Driver MetricsSys: registerSource(AMSource) (in-JVM); 4. Driver MetricsSys to Live Spark UI: attachHandler(/metrics/*) (driver-1:4040); 5. Executor to Exec MetricsSys: ExecutorSource & report() (in-JVM); 6. SparkContext to Driver MetricsSys: report() & stop() (in-JVM)
